name: Mini Dev Pipeline — build → review → test
description: Real pipeline test: developer writes code, verifier reviews, QA tests. Proves the full pipeline works through the new engine.

nodes.body_template: Write a Python function `greet(name)` in greet.py that returns 'Hello, {name}!'. Include a test in test_greet.py. Commit both files.
Review the code changes. Run the tests. Set verdict to PASS or FAIL in your completion metadata.
Test the greet function by running the test suite. Report the result.
